releaseNotes:
1. Streamlined Top Navigation: Cleaned user dropdown by removing redundant PIN and Lock/Exit actions now centralized on the side navigation bar.
2. Startup Session & Lock Persistence: Closing the application without Lock & Exit now seamlessly remembers the last operator; triggering Lock & Exit strictly mandates PIN authentication on next launch.
3. Custom Units of Measurement: Added dynamic custom unit provisioning with '+ New' and inline creation for catalog items.
